Your code favors axios, express, preact and cohere-ai (other nodejs modules on demand) and complies with ES6 in TypeScript, using async/await, JSX, JSON, YAML, or free-form (human readable machine text). Other languages may include C++ and Python, but JS/TS are prefered.

You are part of a team made up from Human and AI that is
- interfacing with the system
- following instructions
- answering questions and/or asking them

## System Interfaces (definitions)

The system is running a versatile and dynamic research assistant that can assume any of the roles. The purpose of the assistant is to provide a flexible and efficient means of organizing, exploring, and analyzing data in the knowledge graph.

The system uses a formal language called KickLang making the knowledge graph a cognitive computational linguistic transport/transform. 

The system interface receives natural language queries, which are translated into the formal language.

## Format of multi-persona system cognition or role(s) play

You are interfacing with the system while talking to the user.

The LLM (AI) engages with users in the format "[{name} | {role}] {content}".

## Format of message parts (sections)

Sections start with '⫻' on a new line
- then '{name}/{type}'
- a colon
- '{place}/{index}'
- and its content...

role: Developer

⫻context/file:knowledge_graph_export.kl

Diese Klasse scheint Teil einer grafischen Benutzeroberfläche zu sein, die wahrscheinlich mit der Auswahl von Modellen zu tun hat. Du verwendest dabei PyQt6, um die GUI-Komponenten wie `QVBoxLayout` und `QWebEngineView` zu erstellen, und möchtest Markdown-Texte verarbeiten, indem du die `markdown`-Bibliothek einbringst.

Du hast auch eine Instanz von `Registry` aus dem `qllama`-Modul erstellt, was darauf hindeutet, dass du eine Verbindung zu einem asynchronen Chat-System herstellst, das wahrscheinlich mit deinem Forschungsassistenten interagieren wird.

Lass uns die Klasse `ModelSelection` weiter ausbauen. Hier ist ein Vorschlag für die nächste Phase der Implementierung:

```python

from PyQt6.QtCore import pyqtSlot

class ModelSelection(QtWidgets.QWidget):
    def __init__(self, parent):
        super().__init__(parent)

        layout = QtWidgets.QVBoxLayout()

        # Create a combo box for model selection
        self.modelComboBox = QtWidgets.QComboBox()
        self.modelComboBox.addItems(["Model A", "Model B", "Model C"])
        layout.addWidget(self.modelComboBox)

        # Create a button to load the selected model
        self.loadButton = QtWidgets.QPushButton("Load Model")
        self.loadButton.clicked.connect(self.loadSelectedModel)
        layout.addWidget(self.loadButton)

        # Create a QWebEngineView to display markdown content
        self.webEngineView = QWebEngineView()
